{{Quote|Welcome traveler, to exciting and adventurous Manaan!|Introductory text of the Manaan Visitor's Guide|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Manaan Visitor's Guide''' was a document issued by the [[Manaan Board of Tourism and Trade]] to beings who were visiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The text of this document assured visitors that they would enjoy a peaceful stay on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] and encouraged them to inform their friends about its positive qualities.
